blind.description: A wall-hanging coat or robe rack featuring a polished brown wooden shelf with carved brackets and pegs underneath. Two brown hooded robes hang from the pegs down toward the floor, and a stylized ivory/cream avian skull sits on top of the shelf. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with clean cloth folds. The model is freestanding on the hems of the hanging robes despite having a flat back intended for a wall.
blind.from_above: A narrow brown rectangular wooden shelf with a pale oval/egg-shaped skull resting near the bottom end, and folds of brown fabric visible underneath.
defects: designed as a wall-mounted shelf/rack but floating/standing freely without a wall
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall, reaching the chest or shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 2.5 feet wide.
